signal: Lambda raised over $1.5B in Series E and signed multi-billion-dollar GPU deals with Microsoft and Nvidia ahead of a possible IPO

email.body1:
J., saw Lambda closed its $1.5B Series E and signed those multi-billion GPU deals with Microsoft and Nvidia.

Scaling that fast usually means more in-market accounts in play than the team can cover before demand outpaces coverage. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for Lambda off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
J., quick follow-up for Lambda.

Post-raise, expectations on pipeline usually jump faster than headcount can, and as Head of Sales Intelligence you know most teams can't pin down how many meetings they need to hit the new number until the gap is already here.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I'll walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings Lambda needs to close that gap, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
J., last bit of proof for Lambda.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Lambda's reply rate likely compares to other fast-scaling AI infrastructure companies. Want to hop on a quick call and I'll walk you through it?
email.body4:
J., I'll stop reaching out on this one, but didn't want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling pipeline without adding headcount isn't a priority this quarter, no problem at all. The stretch right after a mega-round is its own kind of busy.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to your sales intelligence motion? I'll tailor it to Lambda either way.
